dossier_source: artifacts/research/opencode_dossier_v14/promotion_table.json (r68e-dossier14, 114 rows; Normal-first reporting per user rule)
execution_assumptions: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT 5m closed candles; limit entry from next bar, 12-bar expiry; fee 0.0002/fill; stop/timeout market-like; long funding 0.0001/8h short 0; compounding indexed-100; stop-first; DD trade-candle-close sampled; ohlc-v2 suppresses intrabar-entry TP, rejects truncated windows.

fee_reference.note: 1bp = 0.0001 fee fraction. Current operating fee 0.0002 = 2bps per fill. BE values are OLS-extrapolated monthly-zero crossings; dossier bps labels for s0004/combo/confirmed are 10x the OLS fraction (e.g. 0.00544 fraction = 54.4bps at 1bp=0.0001, dossier writes 544bps) — matrix records the FRACTION plus both labels with a discrepancy note; ranking uses the fraction.

formulas.dd_margin: clip((0.20 - abs(DD_normal))/0.20, 0, 1). DD-safe shallow -> near 1; DD-breach -> 0.
formulas.exec_retention: clip(exec_Mo / normal_Mo, 0, 1.2) / 1.2. Rewards keeping monthly under execution stress; >1 (exec pays more) capped at 1.2.
formulas.fee_headroom: clip(ln(BE_frac / 0.0002) / ln(0.015 / 0.0002), 0, 1). UNKNOWN -> 0. BE_frac = monthly OLS break-even fee fraction from the book's own fee-ladder summary.
formulas.forward_oos: DISPLAY ONLY, not scored (only 3/8 books ever forward-tested; scoring it would punish unmeasured books for a protocol gap, not a measured fragility). Tie-break only.
formulas.latency: 1.0 if d2 fills>=30 AND d2_Mo >= 0.9 * family normal_Mo; 0.6 if fills>=30 but deeper decay; 0 if fills<30 or DD explodes; UNKNOWN (never measured on this book) -> 0.
formulas.normal_monthly_norm: (Mo - minMo8) / (maxMo8 - minMo8) over the 8 books' Normal monthly.
formulas.probfill: 1.0 if p=0.2 fills>=30 AND DD<=20%; 0.6 if fills>=30 but DD breach; 0.3 if 20<=fills<30; 0 if fills<20; UNKNOWN (never measured on this book) -> 0.
formulas.volcap: 1.0 if k=5% at indexed capital fills == control fills AND 0 volcap-skipped bars; 0.5 if fills>=30 but degraded/delayed; 0 if fills<30; UNKNOWN (never measured on this book) -> 0.

prespec.intent: Rank by LEAST degradation across the realism bundle, NOT by peak Normal monthly. Normal peak gets only 10% weight; 90% rewards DD headroom, stress retention, and measured survival. Unmeasured cells get 0 on that subscore (conservative for live: absence of evidence is not evidence of robustness) and are flagged UNKNOWN, never imputed.
prespec.note: This config was written BEFORE running scripts/opencode_r69a_realistic.py. The script MUST load weights/formulas from this file, never hardcode its own.
prespec.scorer: scripts/opencode_r69a_realistic.py loads this JSON (weights + formulas + branch map) then compiles frozen numbers.

sources.test_policy: configs/opencode_hypothesis_ledger.json round69.test_policy (headline Normal; realism bundle = Normal + prob-fill ref + volume-cap ref + latency ref + fee tiers)

test_policy.headline: Normal (limit/BTC liquid ~ Normal per user rule)
test_policy.realism_bundle: Normal costs + prob-fill reference + volume-cap reference + latency reference + fee tiers (report all)
test_policy.rule: Selection/thresholds/calibration on DEV only. TEST metrics-once per frozen candidate. No tuning on TEST.
test_policy.test_set: sealed forward window 2026-03-23 -> growing (re-crawl monthly append-only)

unknown_policy: UNKNOWN where a dimension was NEVER measured on that exact book (no cross-book imputation). UNKNOWN scores 0 on that subscore and is flagged per cell with source='UNKNOWN (never measured)'.
